A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Twi'lek''' [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] participated in an [[Ambush in Cloud City|ambush]] set up for [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] in the [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] [[City/Legends|settlement]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] and some other [[Fringer/Legends|fringers]] accompanied the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], who had been hired by the settlement's former owner, [[Dominic Raynor]], after he accused Calrissian of cheating in the [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game in which he lost the city. After faking an emergency call, the scoundrels lured Calrissian to one of the city's maintenance levels, where Calrissian was attacked by the Twi'lek and his companions before fleeing the ambush through a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] lived and worked as a [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]]<ref name="SWM" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="date">The ''[[Sore Loser's Revenge]]'' scenario does not provide a time frame for Bossk's ambush, in which the Twi'lek was present, but the comic [[Lady Luck (comic story)|''Lady Luck'']] states that Calrissian won Cloud City in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Furthermore, the short story ''[[Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array]]'', which describes Raynor's last assassination attempt against Calrissian happening around six weeks after the sabacc match, reveals that the ambush happens within these six weeks.</ref> In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Dominic Raynor]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambled]] away his [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[City/Legends|settlement]] in a game against the professional [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] player [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. Thinking that his opponent had cheated, Raynor hired the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] to capture or [[Death/Legends|kill]] Calrissian, who had become the new [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]]. With the knowledge that his target would be well protected, Bossk contacted some [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Assassin/Legends|cutthroats]], including a [[Unidentified Duros (Ambush in Cloud City)|Duros]], a [[Unidentified Quarren (Ambush in Cloud City)|Quarren assassin]], two Twi'lek scoundrels&mdash;this individual and a [[Unidentified Twi'lek 2 (Ambush in Cloud City)|colleague]] of the same [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;to assist him.<ref name="SLR" />

The Twi'lek and his companions slipped through the security of Cloud City and planned an [[Ambush in Cloud City|ambush]] to capture Calrissian. Bossk impersonated the city's [[Cloud City chief engineer|chief engineer]] and reported to Calrissian that a primary [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] pod was about to break down&mdash;a failure that would destroy the floating city. In response, Calrissian went to the city's lower levels to check the pod, accompanied by his [[Unidentified Twi'lek bodyguard|Twi'lek bodyguard]] and four [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guards]] as a precautionary measure.<ref name="SLR" />

Bossk ordered his companions to take cover but remain in sight to lure Calrissian out. Since they were unsure which [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] Calrissian would arrive in, the Twi'lek and the others spread into every room near the lifts. After Calrissian's group entered the maintenance level, a [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]] suddenly shut behind them, and the ad hoc [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter group opened [[Blaster/Legends|fire]] on the Baron Administrator's [[Bodyguard/Legends|guards]]. With a long [[Dagger/Legends|dagger]], the Twi'lek engaged his opponents, who decided to hold their enemies off while the Baron Administrator escaped through a nearby [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. Thanks to the distress call sent by a member of Calrissian's party, a quartet of Wing Guards arrived to assist the Baron Administrator, who successfully managed to flee from the ambush.<ref name="SLR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TwilekScoundrel-SWM.jpg|thumb|right|100px|The Twi'lek scoundrel's figurine]]
The Twi'lek appeared in ''[[Sore Loser's Revenge]]'', a [[Wizards.com]] online [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] scenario written by [[Eric Cagle]] for the ''[[Star Wars Miniatures]]'' collectible tabletop strategy game in [[2004]]. During the game, one player controls Calrissian's party, and another controls Bossk's party, including the Twi'lek, who is represented by a generic Twi'lek Scoundrel miniature figurine<ref name="SLR" /> from the ''Miniatures'' set [[Rebel Storm (Star Wars Miniatures)|''Rebel Storm'']].<ref name="SWM" /> The survival of the character depends on the players' actions. In an alternate ending to the scenario, the Twi'lek's party kills Calrissian's escorts and captures the Baron Administrator,<ref name="SLR" /> but the short story ''[[Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array]]'' has rendered this ending [[Canon|non-canonical]] by featuring Calrissian free and unharmed a few days after Bossk's ambush.<ref name="idiot">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/fiction/f20080522/index.html|text="Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array"|int=Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>
